correctness.rationale: For every labelled valuation, a modal diamond of a complete Boolean type is true exactly when that type appears in the support. Non-satisfaction equals independent support; every independent size-j support has j!S(n,j) onto maps. Triangular Stirling inversion proves exact reconstruction; padding by isolates to a power-of-two type set gives a polynomial Turing reduction from #IndependentSet; P4 and triangle plus isolate have identical independence coefficients but explicit separating two-world S5 model. Exponential rate follows from the dominant largest independent-support size. A standalone standard-library checker independently verified 82 graph cases and 162300 complete-frame assignments. Finite experiments do not prove complexity or infinite formulas.

value.rationale: Precisely quantifies what finite-model sampling at every model size determines about a shallow epistemic formula, gives an invertible numerical invariant and its exact failure to determine logical equivalence, and shows that model counting remains #P-complete even with a single S5 equivalence component and positive pair-diamond formulas. The exact transform and restricted complexity connect natural modal semantics to graph independent-set enumerators; the smallest witness and sharp rate provide motivated boundaries rather than arbitrary slices.
